definitions.explanation: A vinyl record for playing music. Loanword from English.

examples.japanese: レコードを{集|あつ}めている。
{古|ふる}いレコードを{見|み}つけたので、{聴|き}いてみた。
examples.english: I found an old record, so I gave it a listen.

notes:
Loanword from English "record." In Japanese, primarily refers to vinyl records, but can also mean a record/achievement.

MEANINGS:
1. Vinyl record (music): レコードを{聴|き}く (listen to a record)
2. Record/achievement: {世界|せかい}レコード (world record), レコードを{更新|こうしん}する (break a record)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レコードプレーヤー: record player
- レコード{店|てん}: record shop
- レコードを{集|あつ}める: to collect records
- レコードをかける: to play a record

RELATED TERMS:
- CD (シーディー): compact disc
- アナログ{盤|ばん}: analog record
- LP (エルピー): long-playing record

Vinyl records have experienced a revival in Japan, with many {中古|ちゅうこ}レコード{店|てん} (secondhand record shops) in areas like Shimokitazawa.
